validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE is solidly confirmed by two independent, primary documents: a Russian federal government decree (RF Government Order No. 923-r, 2021-04-09, amending No. 816-r, 2015-05-06, position 34 of the federal territorial-planning scheme for pipeline transport) and a Gazprom-group EPC coordinator (АО «Газстройпром») 2022-03-01 tender/procurement registry listing real, signed (КЗ) civil-works contracts for the exact named object 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС "Усть-Луга"' (object code ГСП-4). Both name the object, agree on capacity (746.7 million m3/year) and location (Leningrad Oblast, Kingisepp district, gas supply for the Ust-Luga industrial zone/port). Caveat only: the row's StartLocation attribution ('Mannovka') is unconfirmed by either source -- see the separate attribution concern -- but the object's core existence, identity, and location are not in doubt.

The sheet records PipelineType='distribution'. Per this batch's own stated classification test -- a row named '<X> - ГРС <Y>' is the отвод (branch/feeder), i.e. the UPSTREAM/transmission side terminating AT the gas-distribution station, not the downstream distribution network fed FROM that station -- this object's own name ('Газопровод-отвод и ГРС "Усть-Луга"', literally 'gas pipeline branch AND gas distribution station Ust-Luga') places it squarely on the transmission side of that boundary: it IS the отвод plus the ГРС itself, not the межпоселковый (intersettlement) distribution mains that lead away from the ГРС into individual settlements. Both primary sources reinforce this: the federal decree places it inside Russia's national pipeline-TRANSPORT planning scheme (not a municipal gasification/distribution programme document), and the Gazstroyprom tender registry groups it with GSP-numbered trunk/branch objects, not municipal межпоселковый distribution-network contracts. Per explicit batch instructions I am flagging this as a classification concern rather than unilaterally overriding the sheet value via a fill -- the PipelineType [ref] fill unit itself is staged UNRESOLVED (no source explicitly applies GEM's own 'distribution'/'transmission' vocabulary to this object), and the contested value here ('transmission') is offered as the researcher's recommended correction for human review, not an applied change.

The neftegazpro page instead describes the route as starting from km 0 on the existing 'Kohtla-Yarve-Leningrad gas pipeline', running through Bolshelutskoe and Ust-Luzhskoe rural settlements (Kingisepp district) to GRS 'Ust-Luga' -- Mannovka is not mentioned. This raises a real possibility that this row's name and StartLocation were built by conflating two separate objects within the same regional gasification programme (a naming/attribution error at some point in this row's history), rather than 'Mannovka' being a genuine, sourceable start point for THIS pipeline. I am not correcting StartLocation myself -- no source states what the correct start-point name should be beyond the unnamed tie-in description above -- but flagging this as a concern for human review; a future pass should try to identify the exact settlement/point at route km 0 on the Kohtla-Yarve-Leningrad line within Bolshelutskoe rural settlement, which may be the true, differently-named start point this row's 'Mannovka' was meant to represent (or may reveal the row should not carry that name at all).

IMPORTANT CAVEAT: a March-2023 Gazprom-subsidiary press release about the DOWNSTREAM intersettlement network (fed FROM this row's own GRS 'Ust-Luga', a separate object not otherwise part of this row) states that network's first stage was already built/commissioned by 2023-03 -- which would typically require the upstream GRS supplying it to already be operational. I am NOT proposing 'operating' because: (1) no source I found states THIS object's (the отвод-and-ГРС itself) commissioning date explicitly; (2) the neftegazpro page's Q1-2024 target completion date is more specific and more directly about this exact object, and postdates the circumstantial March-2023 hint -- the two could both be true if the ГРС came online in stages ahead of the full отвод's formal completion, which is common Russian gasification-project practice; (3) my session's WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200 calls) before I could run a targeted search for an explicit GRS 'Ust-Luga' commissioning announcement. Recommend a follow-up sweep specifically target that question before the sheet is moved past 'construction'. Verdict is 'change' (not 'confirm'/'stale'/'unclear') because the evidence is dated, verified, and unambiguous that 'proposed' with no ref was wrong as of the row's own LastUpdated, even though the exact CURRENT (2026-09) status carries some residual uncertainty documented above.
